method: Each observation is a message sent through the daemon's real delivery path and read back with tg_get_messages, paired with the daemon log line for the same instant. The stored form is quoted verbatim from the API response, not reconstructed.

L6.probe: a LOCAL 116-byte PNG referenced in embed syntax
L6.note: WITHDRAWN 2026-11-13: the fixture was a TRUNCATED PNG, not a valid one. Chunk walk over /tmp/oc-probes/probe-embed.png: IHDR ok, IDAT ok, then 13 bytes remain where a 12-byte IEND chunk must sit — one stray 0x74 precedes it, so the file ends 0x...740000000049454E44AE426082. `file(1)` still called it 'PNG image data, 16 x 16', which is how the earlier record came to say 'valid'. Telegram's IMAGE_PROCESS_FAILED was therefore CORRECT. #829 closed as not-a-defect; §2 rule 1 is UNMEASURED for the local case until a valid fixture is probed. The harness now validates fixtures structurally (probe fixture-l6-local-photo-valid).
